Esvee version 2.1
registered config items:
 -artefact_pon_sgl_file: type(PATH) desc(Additional artefact SGL PON file)
 -artefact_pon_sv_file: type(PATH) desc(Additional artefact SV PON file)
 -asm_build_debug: type(FLAG) desc(Log assembly building working)
 -asm_log_all_reads: type(FLAG) desc(Log assembly all reads even if not used in support)
 -asm_map_qual_threshold: type(INTEGER) default(10) desc(Realign and test assemblies with average map-qual below this threshold)
 -asm_ref_base_write_max: type(INTEGER) default(200) desc(Cap assembly ref bases in TSV and VCF, use zero to write all)
 -assembly_detailed_tsv: type(FLAG) desc(Log extra assembly info to TSV)
 -bam_file: type(PATHS) desc(BAM file paths separated by ',')
 -bam_validation: default(SILENT) desc(BAM validation: STRICT (default), LENIENT or SILENT)
 -bamtool: type(PATH) desc(Path to sambamba or samtools for sort/merge)
 -bwa_lib: type(PATH) desc(Path to BWA library)
 -decoy_genome: type(PATH) desc(Decoy genome image file)
 -disc_only_disabled: type(FLAG) desc(Disable discordant-only junctions)
 -disc_rate_increment: type(DECIMAL) default(0.01) desc(Discordant rate increment)
 -esvee_prep_dir: type(PATHS) desc(Esvee prep input directory)
 -filter_sgls: type(FLAG) desc(Filter SGLs from VCF, intended for tumor-only mode, default=true in target panel)
 -hotspot_min_qual: type(INTEGER) default(30) desc(Hotspot min qual)
 -hotspot_min_support: type(INTEGER) default(2) desc(Hotspot min support)
 -input_vcf: type(PATH) desc(Input VCF)
 -junction_file: type(PATHS) desc(Esvee Prep junction file, default is to match by sample name)
 -known_hotspot_file: type(PATH) desc(Known fusion hotspot BED file)
 -log_debug: type(FLAG) desc(Log at DEBUG level)
 -log_level: desc(Specify log level: ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG or TRACE)
 -log_read_ids: desc(Log specific read IDs, separated by ';')
 -manual_ref_depth: type(INTEGER) default(0) desc(Manually set ref depth for testing)
 -max_frag_length_override: type(INTEGER) default(-1) desc(Set max fragment length instead of calculating)
 -min_align_bases: type(INTEGER) default(50) desc(Junction fragment min aligned bases)
 -min_junction_frags: type(INTEGER) default(2) desc(Required fragments to keep a junction)
 -min_qual: type(INTEGER) default(30) desc(Min qual, panel default: 60)
 -min_support: type(INTEGER) default(4) desc(Min support)
 -no_cache_bam: type(FLAG) desc(Write a BAM to cache candidate reads)
 -no_clean_up: type(FLAG) desc(Keep candidate cache BAM files)
 -no_trim_read_id: type(FLAG) desc(Disable use of a shortened readId internally)
 -output_dir: desc(Output directory)
 -output_id: desc(Output file suffix)
 -partition_size: type(INTEGER) default(1000000) desc(Partition size)
 -perf_debug: type(FLAG) desc(Detailed performance tracking and logging)
 -perf_log_time: type(DECIMAL) default(0.0) desc(Log performance data for routine exceeding specified time (0 = disabled))
 -phase_process_limit: type(INTEGER) default(0) desc(Exclude phase groups above this size from extension and phase sets)
 -pon_margin: type(INTEGER) default(3) desc(PON permitted matching position margin)
 -pon_sgl_file: type(PATH) desc(PON for SGL positions)
 -pon_sgl_margin: type(INTEGER) default(10) desc(PON permitted matching position margin for SGLs)
 -pon_sv_file: type(PATH) desc(PON for SV positions)
 -proximity_distance: type(INTEGER) default(2000) desc(Proximity distance to group variants)
 -purple_dir: type(PATH) desc(Purple data directory for event visualisation)
 -ref_genome: type(PATH) REQUIRED desc(Path to reference genome fasta files)
 -ref_genome_version: REQUIRED desc(Ref genome version, 37 or 38)
 -reference: desc(Reference ID(s), separated by ',')
 -reference_bam: desc(Reference BAM file(s), separated by ',')
 -remote_phase_read_check_threshold: type(FLAG) desc(Apply remote phase building max read check threshold)
 -repeat_mask_file: type(PATH) desc(Repeat mask definitions file)
 -run_assembly_vis: type(FLAG) desc(Run visualiser on specific junctions)
 -saga_fasta: type(PATH) desc(SAGA resource FASTA file)
 -sample: desc(List of samples separated by ',')
 -sequencing_type: default(ILLUMINA) desc(Sequencing types: ILLUMINA, ULTIMA, SBX)
 -sgl_min_support: type(INTEGER) default(6) desc(SGL min support)
 -specific_chr: desc(Restrict to chromosome(s) separated by ';')
 -specific_junctions: desc(Specific junctions: format: Chromosome:Position:Orientation:Type (I, D or none), separated by ';')
 -specific_regions: desc(Restrict to regions(s) separated by ';' in format Chr:PosStart:PosEnd or Chr:PosStart-PosEnd)
 -stages: desc(Stages: PREP;ASSEMBLY;REF_DEPTH;CALLING separated by ';')
 -target_regions_bed: type(PATH) desc(Target regions BED file)
 -threads: type(INTEGER) default(1) desc(Number of threads, 0 or 1 not multi-threaded)
